target: 100% completion of the selected PlayStation 2 route, spoiler-free

areas.name: PlayStation 2 Setup and Global Data
areas.location_cue: The PlayStation 2 title screen, input calibration, options, and memory-card display.
areas.note: Use the home version because it contains the cabinet route plus all additional local modes.

levels.1: Choose the home edition containing the broadest local feature set.
levels.2: Use the original PlayStation 2 release on hardware or a tested emulator.
levels.3: Launch the PAL English or Japanese PlayStation 2 edition and create a dedicated memory-card file. This route contains the arcade campaign plus the home-exclusive Dungeon and Vs. Roach modes, so the separate cabinet version adds no completion content.

levels.1: Progress belongs to one automatically updated record.
levels.2: Keep a backup of the dedicated system-data file before long sessions.
levels.3: Allow the title to finish each automatic write before resetting or closing the emulator. Copy the memory-card image before experimenting with old states; restoring an earlier image can remove later characters, reports, ammunition rewards, and time-based options.

levels.1: Every required mode works with the ordinary pad.
levels.2: Configure a DualShock 2 layout and complete an Arcade run.
levels.3: Set aiming, firing, movement, weapon selection, and camera controls in Options, then calibrate sensitivity in the first stage. Finish one complete Arcade run with the pad so completion does not depend on light-gun hardware.

levels.1: The home release also supports compatible light-gun play.
levels.2: Calibrate a GunCon 2 where your display or emulator supports it.
levels.3: Connect compatible hardware, open the calibration screen, verify all screen edges, and complete one Arcade run. If the chosen modern display or emulator cannot reproduce GunCon 2 input accurately, record the hardware limitation rather than fabricating a clear.

levels.1: Both selectable leads deserve a complete route.
levels.2: Choose Claire and clear all five Arcade stages.
levels.3: Start Arcade as Claire, finish every timed stage in sequence, save the result automatically, and confirm the clear contributes to the partner-level options. Use a later run for jewels, messages, and S grades if the first is exploratory.

levels.1: The second lead carries a different basic weapon.
levels.2: Choose Steve and clear all five Arcade stages.
levels.3: Start a fresh Arcade run as Steve and finish the same five-stage route. Test his starting weapon and character-specific heavy weapon during the run, then wait for the system-data write before returning to the title screen.

levels.1: The home version permits a shared run.
levels.2: Connect a second input and clear Arcade with two players.
levels.3: Join the second player at character selection, choose one lead per player, and finish all five stages. Either player may enter an open stage exit to move both onward, but collect each jewel and message before anyone crosses that boundary.

save_backup.title: Back up the dedicated system file
save_backup.why: Automatic writes hold every time-based option, report, reward, and character unlock.

areas.name: Arcade Completion and Scoring
areas.location_cue: The Arcade character screen, five-stage run, stage result panels, and global options.
areas.note: Explore first, then separate jewel, message, S-grade, solo, and cooperative attempts as needed.

levels.1: Five compact routes form one continuous clear.
levels.2: Finish Stages 1 through 5 without abandoning the run.
levels.3: Select either lead, clear each timed route and its closing combat, then finish the last encounter and allow the ending presentation to conclude. Save the resulting global progress; the optional encounter does not create a different ending.

items.label: Collect All Five Jewels in One Run

levels.1: Each stage hides one colored object inside its route.
levels.2: Take one jewel in every stage before leaving its exit.
levels.3: Collect the red, blue, green, purple, and gold-grey jewels during the same continuous Arcade run. After the normal Stage 5 combat, remain ready for the gated optional encounter; complete it and then preserve the automatic clear data.

levels.1: A full jewel set changes the final combat sequence.
levels.2: Carry all five jewels through the end of Stage 5.
levels.3: Do not spend or drop the stage jewels; they are tracked automatically. Defeat the ordinary final opponent, collect the special launcher presented in the next arena, and finish the additional encounter. The ending afterward is the same, so only the combat itself is a separate requirement.

levels.1: Each route contains one short code away from its exit line.
levels.2: Read FIVE, JEWEL, 25MIN, NEMESIS, and KILL across the five stages.
levels.3: Approach each marked wall, typewriter, or carousel position until its code is clearly registered. Collect all five on local runs even though the historical website they once addressed is unavailable; the codes remain part of the software's discoverable content.

items.label: Earn S on Every Arcade Stage

levels.1: Accurate close shots and an unbroken life bar drive the best results.
levels.2: Finish each stage with an S grade on the result panel.
levels.3: Use close-range critical hits, destroy point-bearing scenery, keep the no-damage chain intact, and finish quickly with the basic weapon whenever safe. Stage 1 requires at least 35,000 points; for later stages, repeat until the displayed result is S because reliable exact thresholds were not published.

levels.1: Ordinary route objects contribute small but useful points.
levels.2: Destroy marked crates and safe breakables before each exit.
levels.3: Shoot every red-cross crate that does not threaten the timer, along with eligible lamps and drums. Each crate adds 200 points, and a full-health first-aid pickup adds a separate bonus, so route these between enemy waves rather than after opening the exit.

levels.1: Very close, centered shots multiply enemy value.
levels.2: Approach safely and land critical hits on suitable targets.
levels.3: Stun or isolate a target, step into the short critical range, center the reticle, and fire once. Do not force this against crowded or lunging enemies; preserving the no-damage bonus can be worth more than a risky multiplier.

levels.1: Clean stages build a growing end-of-stage bonus.
levels.2: Clear consecutive stages without losing health.
levels.3: Learn enemy entrances on a practice file, retreat before ambush triggers, and take no damage from Stage 1 onward. A hit breaks the cumulative chain, so restart early if the current run is intended to record all five S grades.

levels.1: A restricted arsenal earns an end-of-stage bonus.
levels.2: Finish a stage without firing a collected secondary weapon.
levels.3: Keep Claire's handgun or Steve's Golden Lugers equipped for the full stage. A solo basic-weapon clear awards 10,000 points; a two-player clear awards 5,000, so reserve this tactic for routes whose boss can be handled safely without a pickup.

levels.1: Continuing preserves progress but destroys the active score.
levels.2: Reach the stage result without using Continue.
levels.3: If defeated during an S-grade attempt, restart rather than continuing because the accumulated score returns to zero. Use unlocked continues only for exploration, message collection, or time-based option grinding.

save_backup.title: Preserve global data before ranking
save_backup.why: A continue resets the active score even though system progress remains.

levels.2: Clear Clock Tower Mission 1 and save its reward.
levels.3: Choose Clock Tower Mission 1, take three dependable weapons, defeat its area boss, and remain through the score tally. Confirm the handgun ammunition is stored and that Vs. Roach Mode appears at the title menu.

levels.1: Six objectives cover combat, collection, combo, speed, and score.

levels.3: Complete Missions 1 through 6 and verify a result record for each: boss, four jewels, 97 enemies, a 60-hit combo, a sub-six-minute escape, and more than 60 million points. Confirm every ammunition reward afterward.

levels.1: The second map raises every numerical target.
levels.2: Clear all six Underground missions.

levels.3: Select Inferno Mission 3, prepare three suitable weapons, and complete the stated objective in one attempt: defeat 202 monsters. Stay through the result and confirm 50 shotgun shells is added to the persistent Dungeon supply before leaving the mode.

levels.1: Each numbered room set has one fixed target and reward.
levels.2: Complete reach 80-hit combo; earn 20 Magnum rounds.
levels.3: Select Inferno Mission 4, prepare three suitable weapons, and complete the stated objective in one attempt: reach 80-hit combo. Stay through the result and confirm 20 Magnum rounds is added to the persistent Dungeon supply before leaving the mode.

levels.1: Each numbered room set has one fixed target and reward.
levels.2: Complete escape within ten minutes; earn three Panzerfaust torpedoes.
levels.3: Select Inferno Mission 5, prepare three suitable weapons, and complete the stated objective in one attempt: escape within ten minutes. Stay through the result and confirm three Panzerfaust torpedoes is added to the persistent Dungeon supply before leaving the mode.

levels.1: Each numbered room set has one fixed target and reward.
levels.2: Complete score over 90 million; earn 60 rocket shots.
levels.3: Select Inferno Mission 6, prepare three suitable weapons, and complete the stated objective in one attempt: score over 90 million. Stay through the result and confirm 60 rocket shots is added to the persistent Dungeon supply before leaving the mode.

levels.1: Each numbered room set has one fixed target and reward.
levels.2: Complete defeat at least 300; earn Rodrigo character unlock.
levels.3: Select Inferno Mission 7, prepare three suitable weapons, and complete the stated objective in one attempt: defeat at least 300. Stay through the result and confirm Rodrigo character unlock is added to the persistent Dungeon supply before leaving the mode.

levels.1: The largest collection mission spans all three sections.
levels.2: Collect the first breakable crate during Mission 2.
levels.3: At the first suitable breakable cluster, destroy the marked crate and take the jewel before leaving the opening section.

levels.1: The largest collection mission spans all three sections.
levels.2: Collect the room 23 shutter path during Mission 2.
levels.3: After the shutter route opens in room 23, clear the Hunter guarding the continuation and collect the jewel behind that position.

levels.1: The largest collection mission spans all three sections.
levels.2: Collect the room eight zombie chamber during Mission 2.
levels.3: Enter room 8, control the dense zombie group from the doorway, and take the jewel from inside once the pickup line is safe.

levels.1: The largest collection mission spans all three sections.
levels.2: Collect the two long-arm enemy corner during Mission 2.
levels.3: In the corner occupied by two long-armed enemies, defeat or stagger both before stepping in to collect the jewel.

levels.1: The largest collection mission spans all three sections.
levels.2: Collect the area three ending crate during Mission 2.
levels.3: Near the end of Area 3, break the final marked crate and collect the fifth jewel before completing the mission objective.

save_backup.title: Back up before Missions 6 and 7
save_backup.why: Their high score and extermination thresholds gate persistent characters and weapons.

areas.name: Complete Weapon Roster
areas.location_cue: Arcade weapon icons and the Dungeon three-slot loadout screen, ammunition rewards, and character selector.
areas.note: Use every weapon with each eligible character; mode restrictions are part of the ledger.

levels.1: Character and mode restrictions determine where this weapon appears.
levels.2: Use the Knife through Rodrigo Dungeon only.
levels.3: Unlock Rodrigo, start a Dungeon mission as him, equip the Knife, and defeat at least one enemy with its close strike before finishing a mission.

levels.1: Character and mode restrictions determine where this weapon appears.
levels.2: Use the Handgun through Claire basic weapon.
levels.3: Begin Dungeon as Claire, equip her basic Handgun, and use it in a completed mission. Preserve its ammunition reward from the boss challenges.

levels.1: Character and mode restrictions determine where this weapon appears.
levels.2: Use the Golden Lugers through Steve basic weapon.
levels.3: Begin Dungeon as Steve, equip the Golden Lugers, and finish one mission with them active. Their ammunition shares the handgun reward family.

levels.1: Character and mode restrictions determine where this weapon appears.
levels.2: Use the Shotgun through both main characters.
levels.3: Include the Shotgun in a three-weapon Dungeon loadout, collect shell rewards from extermination missions, and fire it during a successful clear with each base character.

levels.1: Character and mode restrictions determine where this weapon appears.
levels.2: Use the Assault Rifle through Claire Dungeon weapon.
levels.3: Choose Claire in Dungeon, assign the Assault Rifle, collect automatic-ammunition rewards, and finish one mission while using it against a dense wave.

levels.1: Character and mode restrictions determine where this weapon appears.
levels.2: Use the Magnum through Claire heavy weapon.
levels.3: Choose Claire, place the Magnum in the Dungeon loadout, earn heavy rounds from a combo mission, and fire it during a successful high-threat clear.

levels.1: Character and mode restrictions determine where this weapon appears.
levels.2: Use the Bow Gun through Claire ranged weapon.
levels.3: Choose Claire, select the Bow Gun among the three starting weapons, and complete a mission after using it against at least one enemy group.

levels.1: Character and mode restrictions determine where this weapon appears.
levels.2: Use the Panzerfaust EX through both Dungeon characters.
levels.3: Assign the Panzerfaust EX to Claire and Steve on separate Dungeon runs, earn torpedoes from speed missions, and complete one mission with each character.

levels.1: Character and mode restrictions determine where this weapon appears.
levels.2: Use the Linear Launcher through special unlock weapon.
levels.3: Unlock the launcher for Claire and Steve through the score threshold and for Chris through Inferno Mission 6. Fire the infinite version as every eligible character.

levels.1: Character and mode restrictions determine where this weapon appears.
levels.2: Use the Rocket Launcher through Dungeon reward weapon.
levels.3: Earn rocket shots from the score missions, assign the Rocket Launcher to a Dungeon loadout, and complete a mission after firing at least one saved round.

levels.1: Character and mode restrictions determine where this weapon appears.
levels.2: Use the Submachine Guns through Steve Dungeon weapon.
levels.3: Choose Steve in Dungeon, assign the Submachine Guns, collect automatic rounds, and finish a mission while using their sustained fire on a wave.

levels.1: Character and mode restrictions determine where this weapon appears.
levels.2: Use the Grenade Launcher through Steve Arcade heavy weapon.
levels.3: Start Arcade as Steve, collect his character-specific heavy-weapon icon, fire the Grenade Launcher during a stage clear, and note that replacing it discards the previous secondary weapon.

save_backup.title: Protect rare ammunition totals
save_backup.why: Dungeon rewards persist, while replacing an Arcade secondary discards the previous pickup.

areas.name: Vs. Roach Lessons
areas.location_cue: Five small insect arenas reached from the home-version title menu.
areas.note: Complete all lessons to unlock the mode-specific infinite heavy weapon.

levels.1: Each compact lesson uses a fixed insect arena.
levels.2: Complete Clock Tower fifth floor; handle ground insects only.
levels.3: Open Vs. Roach after the first Dungeon clear, choose Lesson 1, and eliminate every ground insect in the Clock Tower fifth-floor room before the counter expires.

levels.1: Each compact lesson uses a fixed insect arena.
levels.2: Complete Underground chamber; handle ground insects only.
levels.3: Select Lesson 2 and clear the Underground chamber of every ground insect. Sweep the floor edges before assuming the counter is stalled.

levels.1: Each compact lesson uses a fixed insect arena.
levels.2: Complete Inferno laboratory; handle insects and moths.
levels.3: In Lesson 3's Inferno laboratory, eliminate the ground insects and moths. If one count remains, check the floor for a downed moth and step on it.

levels.1: Each compact lesson uses a fixed insect arena.
levels.2: Complete mixed insect chamber; handle insects and moths.
levels.3: Clear Lesson 4's mixed insect room, alternating high aim for airborne moths with a floor sweep for roaches. Finish every remaining counter entry.

levels.1: Each compact lesson uses a fixed insect arena.
levels.2: Complete laser room; handle avoid wall laser.
levels.3: Enter Lesson 5's laser room, stay away from the active wall beam, and remove every insect without being trapped against its sweep line.

levels.1: Each compact lesson uses a fixed insect arena.
levels.2: Complete clear all five lessons; handle Roach mode only.
levels.3: After all five lessons show complete, return to Vs. Roach, equip the Panzerfaust EX, fire several torpedoes, and confirm its ammunition is unlimited only in this mode.

save_backup.title: Back up after every lesson
save_backup.why: The final reward depends on all five completion flags.

areas.name: Legacy Codes and Current Completion
areas.location_cue: Five in-game message surfaces, the local report menu, and a retired external service.
areas.note: The historical website is unavailable; local messages and reports remain the current achievable requirements.

levels.1: Hidden messages once linked the cabinet to an external page.
levels.2: Record FIVE, JEWEL, 25MIN, NEMESIS, and KILL locally.
levels.3: Collect all five messages inside Arcade and keep them in the completion ledger. Do not attempt to submit them: the linked service closed in December 2003, and present-day completion ends with discovering the in-game codes themselves.

levels.1: One historical external feature can no longer be completed normally.
levels.2: Treat the closed website as unavailable, not as a missing save requirement.
levels.3: The official code-submission page no longer operates, so a modern normal save cannot access that online presentation. Document its retired status internally, collect the five local messages, and do not imply that the inaccessible website is required for current completion.

items.label: Read All Five Local Secret Reports

levels.1: The home port preserves a local counterpart to the hidden discoveries.
levels.2: Unlock and read every title-screen Secret Report.
levels.3: Collect every stage jewel, finish the relevant stages, return to the title-screen report menu, and advance through all five documents. This local collection remains fully achievable even though the old external service is gone.
